title: SFP Synchronization Interface
description: Designs bounded timing and synchronization interface boards using pluggable high-speed connectivity.
constraints: Preserve reference-plane continuity for high-speed and timing paths.
Keep clock noise, module power, and management circuitry appropriately partitioned.
Treat impedance, loss, skew, and stack-up limits as fabricator-dependent constraints.
evidence_requirements: Authoritative host-interface and selected module-form-factor documentation.
Official clock, protection, power, and physical-interface documentation.
Fabricator stack-up evidence for claimed impedance or loss performance.

verification: ERC and DRC findings are reported without concealment.
High-speed, clock, power, and thermal constraints receive independent review.
Unverified channel performance is labeled for simulation or laboratory validation.
acceptance.delivery_policy: Deliver a reviewable implementation and constraint report without claiming unperformed channel, timing, or compliance validation.
